note: Alif Bank's Salom card, a card on a consumer credit line in somoni whose purchases are each repaid on their own schedule. The bank's table of credit products (annex to order 103P-26 of 22 May 2026) prices Salom/Salom Cash at 23% a year as standard, 22% for repeat clients and 20.04% for short loans of up to a month: written as 23% a year from 20.04%. The general terms of its consumer credit line (approved 1 September 2022, the version the bank links) make the card free to issue and to deliver and charge, for a payment not made on time, 0.5% of the principal in the monthly payment due with a floor of 3 somoni: written as a share of the minimum. Their days of grace before that charge (1 to 6), the interest-free period set for each purchase (1 to 730 days) and the commission set for each purchase aren't written; no yearly fee is published. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): no bank was added. Tried: Eskhata Bank's and Humo's home pages answered (a form's captcha only) but weren't read further for want of time; Amonatbonk didn't answer. Wave 5 (2026-10-30), minimum payments: No minimum payment is published for Alif Bank's Salom card: each purchase is repaid on its own schedule under the credit line's general terms (read again 2026-10-30), not as a share of a statement; tried: those terms and the product table, and archive.org (no answer).
